name: J.K'S EVERYDAY
source:
[b]J.K is a sad, [i]sad[/i] little man who works in real estate.[/b]

His boss is a literal pig and he is the only one who can understand it. His tenant sucks, as does his life. His only friends cannot even provide console as they’re even [i]more[/i] swamped with work than usual. 

To make matters worse, the plague is approaching J.K’s humble abode at an alarming pace.

Can he survive the rat invasion?

[From [url=https://jimothie.itch.io/jksed-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[b]J.K是一个悲伤的人，[i]伤心[/i]在房地产行业工作的小个子。[/b]他的老板是一只不折不扣的猪，只有他能理解这一点。他的房客很糟糕，他的生活也很糟糕。他唯一的朋友甚至无法提供安慰，因为他们甚至[i]更多的[/i]比平常更忙于工作。

更糟糕的是，瘟疫正以惊人的速度逼近J.K. 简陋的住所。

他能在老鼠入侵中幸存下来吗？

[来自[url=https://jimothie.itch.io/jksed-demo]痒痒io[/url]]
